info.title: Wardrik
info.description: Wardrik's agents over HTTP. Each operation's x-wardrik-function names the function of the Elixir module Wardrik it calls. A chat channel's requests, under /v1/channels/, are the channel's own, and call none. Every request presents a bearer token, whose statements each allow some actions on the resources a pattern covers, as acme/agent/*; an agent none reaches is answered as one that does not exist, 404, and one reached without the action, 403. An expired token is answered 401. Every answer of 400 and above is an error, as v1/error.json describes. Besides those each operation lists, any route answers 500 where something went wrong, and 503 where credentials cannot be checked.
